{{Top|leg}}
A '''thildas''' was an [[Ebranite]] clan. Generally consisting of between twenty to thirty families, each member of the thildas lived and worked in the same area. Each clan had a unique insignia that members had [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on their uppermost left arm.<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

Each thildas was ruled by a leadership council known as the [[ghantar]]. Two of the main clans, the [[Rull]] and the [[Jih-tan]], maintained a millennia-long rivalry.<ref name="GG12" />
